conflicts.permit: We use an opt-out standard for all communications other than administrative communication concerning your account.
conflicts.prohibit: Such marketing communications will only be sent to you if you have consented thereto through an ‘Opt-in’.
conflicts.situation: Sending marketing communications to a user via email.
conflicts.reason: One section mandates that marketing communications are sent only via opt-in consent, while another states that an opt-out standard applies to non-administrative communications.
